ios.name: Pitch Perfect (Pitch Pipe)
ios.subtitle: A pitch pipe for singers
ios.description:
Pitch Perfect is a digital pitch pipe for the musically inclined. Find your starting note before a rehearsal, warm up with your choir, or get a song going with friends. Just press and hold a note to hear it.

Not sure which key goes with the sharps or flats on your sheet music? Match the key signature on the page to the one on your screen, then sound its starting pitch. Keep a list of songs and their keys so you're ready for the next one.

With Pitch Perfect you can:
- Play individual notes or sound several together as a chord.
- See note names and frequencies as you play.
- Find starting pitches from major and minor key signatures.
- Add songs, save their keys, and drag to arrange your singing order or sort alphabetically.
- Sound a note from a Home Screen widget.
- Use light or dark appearance on your phone or tablet.

Pitch Perfect generates a simple tone based on a sine wave. The aim is quick, easy access to a reference pitch when you need it.

Questions, problems, or feature requests? Email support@davidpoll.com.
ios.promotional_text: Find your starting pitch, sound chords, and keep your songs and keys ready for rehearsal.
